metadata.source: OWASP Cheat Sheets, Public remediation knowledge

remediations.xss: Output encoding (HTML, attribute, JS, URL), Content Security Policy, validate input, use frameworks that auto-escape, HttpOnly cookies, X-XSS-Protection
remediations.sqli: Parameterized queries (prepared statements), ORM, input validation, least privilege DB user, WAF as defense in depth
remediations.ssti: Avoid user input in templates, sandbox, validate input, least privilege
remediations.ssrf: Validate URLs, allow list, deny list for private IPs, disable unnecessary URL schemas, use allow list
remediations.xxe: Disable XML external entities, use JSON, validate XML, patch libraries
remediations.idor: Authorization check for every request, random IDs (UUID), deny by default, log access failures
remediations.bola: Check authorization for every request, random unpredictable IDs, deny by default
remediations.bfla: Check authorization for every request, method-level authz, deny by default
remediations.auth_bypass: Proper authentication, authorization, MFA, secure session management, no default creds, strong password policy
remediations.open_redirect: Allow list for redirect URLs, validate redirect param, no user-controlled redirect without validation
remediations.s3_exposure: Private ACL, block public access, encryption, logging, versioning
remediations.cors_misconfig: Validate Origin, allow list, not *, no credentials with *
remediations.csrf: Anti-CSRF tokens, SameSite cookies, validate Origin/Referer
remediations.general: Defense in depth, least privilege, validate input, encode output, secure defaults, logging, monitoring
